statusLine.command: PROFILE=$(cat $HOME/.claude/.profile 2>/dev/null || echo default); HOST=$(hostname); BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); jq -r --arg profile "$PROFILE" --arg host "$HOST" --arg branch "$BRANCH" '"[" + env.HOST_DIR + "] " + $profile + " | " + $host + (if $branch != "" then " | " + $branch else "" end) + " | " + .model.display_name + " | " + ((.context_window.used_percentage // 0) | tostring) + "% context"'
